## Why two files

EPR-001 v1.13.0 carries **no temporal values**. Its beats bind to segment IDs, and its `segment_authority_note` bars resolving a segment_ref to a timecode. The spans live in TIMELINE_REGISTRY. The Chairman directed on 2026-09-30 that the Tier-1 rebase lands in a TIMELINE_REGISTRY proposal, with EPR-001 changing only by header, version and changelog.
